title: Regenerate Xcode project with xcodegen
description: Run `xcodegen generate` from the repository root after all new Swift source files are in place. The .xcodeproj is gitignored and must be regenerated before xcodebuild or the test runner can resolve the new files. Verify that `xcodebuild build` succeeds after regeneration.
acceptance_criteria: All new Swift files in CookbookApp/Recipes/ appear in the regenerated build target.

handoff_summary.completed: xcodegen generate completed without errors. All new Swift files in CookbookApp/Recipes/ (CookwareView, IngredientsView, RecipeBottomBar, RecipeDetailSheet, RecipeHeroHeader, RecipeStatStrip, RecipeStepCombiner, RecipeTagChips, StepsView, and others) appear in the regenerated build target. xcodebuild build succeeded for the iOS Simulator platform.
handoff_summary.next_action: Ready for tester agent to run the full test suite against the regenerated project.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: The .xcodeproj is gitignored so no merge conflicts expected; if any sibling bead also runs xcodegen, the last write wins (idempotent for a given project.yml state).
handoff_summary.design_decisions: project.yml sources the entire CookbookApp/ directory recursively, so xcodegen automatically includes any new Swift files without manual entries.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Build verified via xcodebuild for iOS Simulator. Test execution deferred to tester agent.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The .xcodeproj is not committed (gitignored). The tester or CI pipeline must re-run xcodegen before running tests if the worktree is freshly cloned.

conflict_risks: The .xcodeproj is gitignored so no merge conflicts expected; if any sibling bead also runs xcodegen, the last write wins (idempotent for a given project.yml state).
